subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four stale SHA assertions are repaired and exact-head checks pass, should the 12 action-package upgrades be accepted as one privileged workflow batch?
rationale: Mechanical correctness is clear, but this batch replaces third-party code executing with app keys, repository tokens, registry credentials, scanning permissions, publishing access, and agent API keys.

options.title: Repair and approve batch
options.body: Synchronize the assertions, require green exact-head workflow and security checks, and approve the verified official releases together.

options.title: Split privileged upgrades
options.body: Separate token-bearing, publishing, scanning, and Codex Action changes into narrower owner-reviewed pull requests.

options.title: Retain current pins
options.body: Pause the grouped adoption and keep the current action commits until a later approved maintenance window.

recommendation.title: Repair and approve batch
recommendation.body: Synchronize the assertions, require green exact-head workflow and security checks, and approve the verified official releases together.
